notablePrerequisites: You have at least four cards in hand.
description:
Cast Inner Fire by paying {3}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Inner Fire.
Resolve the copy of Inner Fire, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have at least five cards in hand to start the combo, this combo nets infinite red mana.
